sonnet.problem: The opening card (card 1) already names the king's chief cupbearer as the man who has forgotten Joseph. That makes the answer to 'Who speaks up?' easy to guess before the question appears.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The question says 'with this reserve', which points back to the previous choice card (card 14). The baker can't see that card, so the question doesn't stand on its own.
sonnet.rule: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
